6. Statement of movable property like Cash and Cash Balance, etc., valuing individually over two months' basic pay or t 1 lakh.
7. NOTE 1.- Details of deposits in the foreign banks to be given separately.
8. NOTE 2.- Investments above t 2 lakhs to be reported individually. Investments below t 2 lakhs may be reported together.
